narr: Slow and back-building showers and storms created localized flooding in portions of West Virginia during the late evening of June 10th. ||Media report on flooding: https://www.wboy.com/news/marion/heavy-rain-causes-flooding-in-marion-county-business-forced-to-close-down/.
ev: Multiple reports of flooded areas, including Pike Street and Howard Street. Fairmont Bowl Center had water inside, 2 to 3 inches deep. The rain was so heavy on Kirckway Drive, in Fairmont, that it caused Coal Run Creek to overflow. The water came over the barrier and caused a sink hole.
High water reported on US19 at Bell Run.
